svg.aria-label: About. Engineer and CISO at NFCtron in Prague. I build payment software and keep it hard to break. Experience: CISO and Head of Development, Since Jan 2026; Core Backend Developer Lead, Oct 2024 to Jan 2026; Core Backend Developer, Jun 2023 to Oct 2024. Backend-first engineer who leads development and security at NFCtron, a payment platform for live events, and at NFCtron Pay, which handles its card payments. I have worked across the chain: ticketing and payments in TypeScript and NestJS, bank payouts and invoicing, Android point-of-sale apps and a PCI MPoC-certified Tap to Pay terminal.
